title: App updates
descriptionDevelopment: Release updates belong to the stable channel. Development builds update through your local workflow.
description: New versions come from the {{repository}} releases on GitHub. Update checks and downloads only read from GitHub; no gameplay data is uploaded.

state.checking: Checking GitHub for a new release…

authHint: The app checks once when it starts. Releases from this private repository are read with your GitHub CLI sign-in; if a check fails to authenticate, run <0>gh auth login</0> in a terminal and check again. The CLI is only for updates: the app and its installer run without it.
publicHint: The app checks once when it starts. Releases are read from GitHub directly, with no sign-in.
guidedHint: The app checks once when it starts, reading this private repository's releases through your GitHub CLI sign-in.

caption.available: Downloading stages the new version beside this one and verifies its checksum. Nothing changes until you restart.
caption.downloading: You can keep playing and leave this page; the download continues. Nothing changes until you restart.
caption.blocked: Save or discard your settings changes before restarting.
caption.ready: Restarting saves collected results, then restarts into {{version}}. Unsaved settings changes are not kept, so save them first. It never restarts on its own, so pick a quiet moment.
caption.restarting: If saving fails, the app stays open, keeps capturing and stays on this version.

developmentNotice: Development build. Check, download and install releases from the stable app.
needsDesktop: Updates need the desktop app. This preview cannot check GitHub or install anything.
failed: {{error}} This version keeps running and capture is unaffected.
failedUnknown: The update could not be completed.
unreachable: Could not reach the update service: {{error}}

sample.hint: Sample text showing how release notes are laid out, taken from earlier pull requests. It is not a release: development builds never check for updates.

available.title: Version {{version}} is available. Open App updates in Settings to download it.

downloading.title: Downloading {{version}} in the background. Open App updates in Settings to follow it.

ready.title: Version {{version}} is downloaded and verified. Open App updates in Settings to restart into it.

portable.notice: This is a portable copy, so it cannot update itself. It still checks for new releases.
portable.caption: Download the installer from the latest release for automatic updates, or replace this file with a newer version by hand.
portable.available: Version {{version}} is out: download the installer for automatic updates, or replace this file with the new version by hand.
portable.signIn: The private release page needs a GitHub sign-in in your browser.

access.title: GitHub access for updates
access.intro: This build's updates come from a private GitHub repository, so checking for them needs a GitHub account with access to it. The installer and the app work without any of this, and you never need to download the repository, Git, Node or Rust.

state.unknown: Access has not been checked yet.
state.checking: Checking GitHub CLI and access to {{repository}}…
state.signing_in: Finish signing in in the GitHub CLI window. Access is checked again as soon as it closes.
state.cli_missing: GitHub CLI was not found on this PC.
state.signed_out: GitHub CLI is installed, but not signed in to GitHub.
state.no_access: Signed in, but this account's access to {{repository}} is not confirmed yet. The invitation may not have been sent or accepted, or GitHub CLI may be signed in with a different account.
state.error: The last check or sign-in did not finish, so access is unknown. This does not mean access was refused.
state.ready: Signed in, and this account can read releases from {{repository}}. Check for updates works as usual.

cli.title: Install GitHub CLI
cli.body: GitHub's official command-line tool. Install it with its default options; Aion Companion finds it without a restart.

signIn.title: Sign in with your invited GitHub account
signIn.body: A GitHub CLI window opens: follow its prompts and confirm the one-time code in your browser. GitHub CLI manages this sign-in itself; Aion Companion never sees your password or code. Being signed in to github.com in your browser is not the same as signing in to GitHub CLI.
signIn.git: If GitHub CLI asks whether to authenticate Git with your GitHub credentials, choose No: updates do not need Git, and Yes stops the sign-in when Git is not installed.
signIn.manual: Open a terminal, such as PowerShell, run this command and follow its prompts, then check access:
signIn.unsupported: This copy cannot open the sign-in window. Open a terminal, such as PowerShell, run this command and follow its prompts, then check access:

invite.title: Get access to the repository
invite.body: The owner invites your GitHub account to {{repository}}, and you accept the invitation from your GitHub notifications or its email. Signed in before it arrived? Accept it, then check access again.

access.checkHint: Checking only asks GitHub CLI; it never changes your sign-in.
access.unreachable: Could not reach the access check: {{error}}
